name: Ezra Schwarcz
headline: I design, build and ship full-stack products.
intro: Web apps, mobile apps and the systems behind them: accounts, databases, admin tools, email, analytics and search. One person accountable from first sketch to launch.

services.title: Web apps
services.text: Fast, search-friendly sites and apps in Next.js and React, built to be found on Google and to load quickly on a phone.

services.title: iPhone and Android apps
services.text: One codebase for both stores with React Native and Expo, sharing accounts and data with your website.

services.title: Redesigns
services.text: Take a site that works and make it look and feel like a product people trust, without losing what already ranks.

services.title: Accounts and data
services.text: Sign-in by email code, Google or passkey. A Postgres database with access rules enforced in the database itself, not just the screen.

services.title: Admin tools
services.text: A control room so you run the product yourself: content, members, moderation, email and the numbers that matter.

services.title: Growth plumbing
services.text: Structured data for search, share cards, lifecycle email, attribution and funnels, so you can see what is working.

process.title: Scope
process.text: A short call and a written plan: what ships first, what waits, what it costs.

process.title: Build in the open
process.text: You get a live preview link for every change and approve it before it goes live.

process.title: Launch
process.text: Your domain, your accounts, your code. Everything is in your name from day one.

process.title: Hand over
process.text: Plain-language docs and an admin screen, so you are never stuck waiting on a developer.

howIWork: I work AI-assisted and review everything that ships. That is how a product the size of Tohu Movies goes from redesign to launch in days, not quarters.
